title: Rule Cleanup Deck

pairs.ask: Love Button: Swipe Decks Only Or Dropped Everywhere?

optionA.label: Swipe Decks Only
optionA.desc: Keep No, Maybe, Love, Yes on swipe decks. Questionnaires keep Yes, Maybe, No.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#C1502E"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">LOVE BUTTON</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Swipe Decks Only</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Keep No, Maybe, Love, Yes on swipe</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">decks. Questionnaires keep Yes, Maybe,</text><text x="18" y="124" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">No.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Drop Everywhere
optionB.desc: Remove Love from every deck and questionnaire to match Coach's Oct 14 change.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">LOVE BUTTON</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Drop Everywhere</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Remove Love from every deck and</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">questionnaire to match Coach's Oct 14</text><text x="18" y="124" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">change.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Coach Suggestions (5 Cards): A Deck That Must Be 20 Or A Short Questionnaire?

optionA.label: Short Questionnaire
optionA.desc: The 3 to 5 daily suggestions stay a short questionnaire, outside the 20-card rule.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#C1502E"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">QUESTIONNAIRE SIZE</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Short Questionnaire</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The 3 to 5 daily suggestions stay a</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">short questionnaire, outside the</text><text x="18" y="124" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">20-card rule.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Must Be 20
optionB.desc: It counts as a deck, so it is padded or merged to exactly 20 cards.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">QUESTIONNAIRE SIZE</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Must Be 20</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">It counts as a deck, so it is padded</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">or merged to exactly 20 cards.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionA.desc: Every board keeps a slim name and Apps Home bar at the top while scrolling.

pairs.ask: Rulebook And Brand Guide Disagree: Rulebook Wins For Dashboards Or Brand Guide Wins?

optionA.label: Rulebook Wins
optionA.desc: For dashboards the numbered rulebook decides; the brand guide covers everything else.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#C1502E"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">WHICH FILE WINS</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Rulebook Wins</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">For dashboards the numbered rulebook</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">decides; the brand guide covers</text><text x="18" y="124" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">everything else.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionB.label: Brand Guide Wins
optionB.desc: The brand guide stays the top source and the rulebook follows it.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">WHICH FILE WINS</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Brand Guide Wins</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">The brand guide stays the top source</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and the rulebook follows it.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Dashboard Spec Still Says One-Line Report: Point It At The Rulebook Or Edit The Text?

optionA.desc: Replace the old Layout Standards list in the spec with a link to the rulebook.

optionB.desc: Keep the list in the spec and update each line to match the rulebook.

pairs.ask: When A Rule Changes: Quote The Old Version Or Just The New?

pairs.ask: Grok Bot 7:18 Chat Brief: Keep It Next To 5:00 Reports Or Fold It In?

pairs.ask: A Settled Rule Comes Back In A Deck: Allow Retests Or Never Re-Ask?

optionA.label: Never Re-Ask
optionA.desc: Once you settle a rule, decks do not ask it again.

optionB.label: Allow Retests
optionB.desc: A settled rule may come back once if a board looks wrong with it.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#737373"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">SETTLED RULE RETESTS</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Allow Retests</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">A settled rule may come back once if a</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">board looks wrong with it.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Customer-Facing Means Niko's Apps Only: Add To The Rulebook Now Or After Launch?

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-width:100%;height:auto"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#C1502E"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".8">CUSTOMER-FACING</text><text x="18" y="60" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Add It Now</text><text x="18" y="94" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Add Max 22:07 to the rulebook today:</text><text x="18" y="109" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">only Niko's apps are customer-facing.</text><text x="120" y="288" font-size="7" fill="#9A948A" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">Built By Max Weberman</text></svg>

optionA.desc: One line in the rulebook: every page except Niko's apps is password-locked.

optionA.desc: Never more than five decks; an urgent deck replaces the oldest.

optionB.label: Allow A Sixth
optionB.desc: An urgent deck may sit as a sixth until it is answered.
